svg.aria-label: Left: a branching vascular tree obeying Murray's law from trunk to capillary. Right: a tissue detail showing capillaries ~400 µm apart, each supplying cells within a ~200 µm diffusion range, with vascular volume about one percent.
svg.text: A · one lawful tree — trunk to capillary
Murray's law: r³ = Σ (child r)³ → space-filling at least pumping cost
~40 branchings from a metre-wide trunk to a ~20 µm capillary (a human body: ~30).
B · every cell ≤ ~100 µm from a channel
◍ channel • living cell ◌ diffusion range · vascular volume ~1%; matrix fills the rest
